string.text: A member of the scientific expedition working from an autonomous field bunker.
Military guard
Warrant Officer Shmatko
What are you snooping around here for, stalker?
A serviceman assigned to protect the scientific expedition.
If your gear needs repairs, show me.
If you need scientific supplies, you may examine our stock.
See you.
Anything else?
Nothing for now, commander.
Keep your weapon down near the bunker. The scientists are under our protection.
Understood, Captain. Is everything quiet?
For now. Silence never lasts long in the Zone.
Want help if trouble starts?
Stay out of our line of fire and follow orders. That will be enough.
Copy that.
Holding my post. You can see a long way from the roof.
Anything suspicious?
Only wind and a few blind dogs on the horizon.
What if you spot movement?
I report to the Captain, then give them a proper welcome.
Right. I will let you work.
I am watching the approaches. Best not to loiter in my view.
What do you see?
Tracks by the embankment and two mutants far to the east.
Any immediate danger?
Not yet. If they come closer, the first burst will tell you.
Got it.
Third shift in a row. My eyes are closing, but I cannot leave the post.
Should I call your relief?
My relief is on the roof. He has it no easier.
At least they could get you some coffee.
The scientists drank it all. Discipline is keeping me awake.
Do not fall asleep, soldier.
The door is locked.\nAsk the security commander\nhow to get inside.
Enter the bunker

The bunker door is locked.
Speak to the military security
commander near the bunker
and find out how to gain access.

The commander gave you
the coordinates.
Find the case at the specified
location and deliver it personally.
Do not open it.
You found the case.\nReturn to the bunker\nsecurity commander and hand it over.

The case has been delivered.
Bring the commander
one bottle of vodka
so he will unlock the door.
Commander's case

A heavy locked case
of unknown contents.
Warrant Officer Shmatko strictly
ordered you not to open it
and to deliver it directly to him.
Good day. Can I enter the bunker, or is it closed to visitors?
Belay that! For what purpose do you need to enter a protected facility?
I was hoping to earn enough not to starve.
Earn something? Do you have documents? Never mind the documents. Let me think... I can arrange an opportunity for you to gain access, but first you need to run somewhere and retrieve something.
I am ready.
Excellent. Here are the coordinates. Retrieve the case and deliver it to me personally. Try to disappear and I will know. Try to open it and I will shoot you. Understood? Then get moving.
Understood. I am on my way.
I brought the case, Commander.
Excellent. Now I am prepared to consider your request.
I do not understand. You said I only had to bring the case...

Belay that! I clearly said I was prepared to arrange an opportunity. Was I unclear? Or should I inspect your documents? Relax. You brought the case, so I will open the doors, say, for one little bottle of vodka.
Here you are.
Understood. I will be back soon.
I already gave you the vodka.
Now that is in order. Access granted. The bunker door is unlocked.
